description: Audit a whole project before an agent installs or runs it: JSON body {manifest, type, readme}. manifest is package.json (npm) or requirements.txt (PyPI) text. Checks up to 25 dependencies against OSV.dev advisories, deprecation and latest versions, and screens the optional README for prompt injection. Returns one safe, caution or avoid verdict plus a ranked fix list (upgrade to version X). Price $0.05 USDC per call via x402. Example output: {"verdict":"avoid","ecosystem":"npm","manifest_type":"package.json","summary":{"dependencies_found":2,"checked":2,"not_checked_over_limit":0,"lookup_failed":0,"avoid":1,"caution":0,"known_vulnerabilities":5},"fixes":[{"priority":"high","package":"lodash","action":"upgrade to >= 4.17.21","why":["5 kn

manifest.description: package.json or requirements.txt contents as a string, max 200,000 chars

readme.description: Optional README or docs text to screen for prompt injection, max 50,000 chars

name: dependency_audit
